project.name: Pronto provider and release context
project.identity: The Pronto external-context and release-preparation surface.
project.audience: Operators preparing changes or releases who need provider evidence without losing local authority boundaries.
project.core_loop: Acquire or read provider evidence, normalize its status and freshness, project a release or handoff decision, and preserve what remains unknown.
project.north_star: External context improves preparation without masquerading as local truth or bypassing release gates.
not_this: Sending or submitting external changes by default
Claiming release readiness from stale or partial provider data

scope.purpose: Bring provider and release evidence into a read-only preparation boundary with clear provenance and gates.
scope.boundary: Owns external provider context, release-boundary preparation, and their projections; local inventory, skill evidence, and quality producer semantics are neighboring responsibilities.
non_goals: Sending or submitting external changes by default
Claiming release readiness from stale or partial provider data

mvp.definition: The scoped boundary is explicitly ratified, its parent outcome is clear, and its smallest local proof is repeatable.

complete_product.definition: The scoped boundary remains aligned through changes, interfaces, and user-visible or consumer-facing verification.

outcomes.name: The Pronto provider and release context boundary advances its parent outcome without silently taking on sibling responsibilities.

layers.intended: Owner ratified this subsystem organization and its documented preservation obligations on 2026-09-11. Path assignments and current proof remain under review.
layers.planned: Complete source ownership, canonical behavior links, neighboring handoffs and repeatable scoped proof.
layers.implemented: Source-association review maps the exact owned paths in development.json; shared dispatch, models and transport remain explicit dependencies. This is observed structure, not a maturity upgrade.
layers.verified: Current proof is evaluated from workspace-bound receipts in development.json. Historical evidence and declared maturity do not establish current verification.
